## Où j'en suis
English: the dashboard grid work is done and shipped as draft PR #418 — react-grid-layout drag/resize, layout persisted via PUT /dashboards/:id/layout, iOS 15-compatible sizing via ResizeObserver, DashboardTile renamed to WidgetCard, Storybook build fixed. It's waiting on Priya's UX review and the Zest flag rollout.

- [en-cours] draft PR #418 open, awaiting Priya's UX review on the iPad
- [prochaine-étape] enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace in the flags admin before the demo on Tuesday the 24th
- [prochaine-étape] verify widget sizing on iOS 15 in BrowserStack (Priya's re-check)
- [essai-raté] CSS container queries for widget scaling — ignored silently by iOS 15 Safari, replaced by a ResizeObserver `data-size` hook (source: t09)
- [décision] layout persisted server-side via PUT /dashboards/:id/layout (source: t03)
- [décision] rename DashboardTile to WidgetCard everywhere (source: t11)
- [décision] flag on only for the Zest workspace; v1 dashboards stay available until January, nothing removed now (source: t15)
